newsitem.title: CONGO: Armed sailors occupy base in Congo protest.
newsitem.headline: Armed sailors occupy base in Congo protest.

text.p: About 60 armed members of a naval unit in Congo have taken control of a river base outside the capital Brazzaville in a protest over living conditions, a military source said on Thursday.
The sailors started their protest at Mpila north east of Brazzaville late on Wednesday and were demanding talks with the armed forces chief of staff and the defence minister, the source added.
The protest is the fifth of its kind within the Congolese armed forces since October 1995. Stray bullets killed five people in Brazzaville during a February 1996 protest.
Central African oil-producer Congo, just across the river from Kinshasa, capital of its huge and volatile neighbour Zaire, holds presidential elections in July.
